d: Manage day-to-day receivables and collections for TruKKer’s Oman customer portfolio. The role drives timely cash recovery, reduces overdue ageing and keeps customer accounts clean and reconciled.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or related field.
3–6 years of experience in B2B collections, accounts receivable or credit control.
GCC experience required; Oman market experience strongly preferred.
Logistics, transportation or supply-chain industry background preferred.
Strong follow-up discipline, negotiation skills and comfort dealing directly with customer finance teams.
Proficiency in ERP systems and MS Excel; familiarity with Oman VAT and e-invoicing requirements an advantage.
English required; Arabic preferred for the Oman customer base.
Valid Oman driving licence preferred for customer visits.
r: li
Own an assigned portfolio of Oman customer accounts and deliver monthly collection targets.
li
Follow up on due and overdue invoices through calls, emails and customer visits; escalate ageing accounts as per the collections process.
li
Share invoices, SOAs and supporting documents (PODs, delivery notes) with customers and resolve queries that delay payment.
li
Reconcile customer accounts, allocate receipts accurately, and clear unapplied cash and short payments.
li
Coordinate with Sales/KAM, Operations and Finance to resolve billing disputes, POD gaps and documentation issues blocking collection.
li
Track and report DSO, ageing buckets, collection forecasts and daily collection activity.
li
Negotiate payment plans with customers within approved limits and flag accounts requiring credit hold or legal escalation.
li
Maintain accurate records of all collection activity, commitments and follow-ups in the system.
li
Support VAT and e-invoicing compliance on invoicing and documentation, in line with Oman Tax Authority (OTA) requirements.

d: AtkinsRéalis is seeking a talented and experienced Structural Engineer to support the design review, construction oversight, and delivery of a major mega infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This transformational program comprises extensive infrastructure networks, bridges, retaining structures, utility corridors, tunnels, public realm developments, landscape structures, and associated civil engineering assets that will contribute to the Kingdom's vision for sustainable urban growth.

The Structural Engineer will be responsible for providing technical expertise and engineering support across the planning, design, construction, and handover phases of the project. Working within the PMCM team, you will ensure that structural solutions meet design intent, safety requirements, regulatory standards, constructability objectives, and project performance criteria. The role requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders to deliver structurally sound, innovative, and efficient infrastructure solutions.
Review and assess structural designs, calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical submissions for infrastructure and landscape-related assets.
Provide engineering oversight during construction to ensure compliance with approved designs, codes, standards, and project requirements.
Support the coordination of structural interfaces across roads, bridges, tunnels, retaining walls, utility structures, landscape features, and associated infrastructure works.
Review contractor shop drawings, materials submissions, construction methodologies, temporary works designs, and inspection requests.
Conduct site inspections and monitor construction activities to verify quality, safety, and compliance with approved structural requirements.
Identify design conflicts, technical issues, and construction challenges and provide practical engineering solutions.
Coordinate with civil, geotechnical, utilities, landscape, architecture, and construction teams to facilitate project delivery.
Support value engineering initiatives while maintaining structural integrity, safety, and project objectives.
Participate in technical reviews, risk assessments, constructability reviews, and design coordination meetings.
Assist in monitoring project progress and provide technical input on schedule, quality, and performance-related matters.
Ensure compliance with international design standards, local regulations, and project governance requirements.
Support testing, commissioning, inspection, and handover activities associated with structural assets.
Prepare technical reports, review comments, engineering recommendations, and site observation records.
Contribute to the successful delivery of project milestones through proactive technical leadership and stakeholder engagement.
q: Bachelor's degree in Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 8-15 years of experience in structural engineering for major infrastructure, transportation, utilities, public realm, or landscape development projects.
Proven experience working on large-scale infrastructure programs involving bridges, retaining walls, underground structures, utility infrastructure, landscape structures, and civil works.
Strong knowledge of reinforced concrete, structural steel, precast systems, foundations, and temporary works design principles.
Experience reviewing structural calculations, design reports, engineering drawings, construction methodologies, and contractor submissions.
Familiarity with international design standards and codes including ACI, AISC, Eurocodes, BS Standards, and other relevant structural design frameworks.
Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary design and construction teams in complex project environments.
Proficiency with structural engineering software and tools such as STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS, SAFE, MIDAS Civil, or equivalent platforms.
Strong technical problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working within PMCM, consultancy, owner representative, or client-side organizations is highly desirable.
Understanding of construction supervision, quality management, risk mitigation, and HSE requirements on large projects.
Previous experience on GCC infrastructure programs, particularly within Saudi Arabia, would be advantageous.
Professional registration or membership with recognized engineering institutions is preferred.

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Summer Technology Analyst Program is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…

The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology.
Your time here will look like this...

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.
While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)

Generative AI & AI Agents: GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:
Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria
Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.
Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
